prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise character redesign. Asset: AAA playable character approval concept sheet for Forbidden Code: Survivor. The attached image is the previous ZERO design. Preserve ONLY the name ZERO, rendering quality, futuristic hoverboard gameplay, cobalt precision-energy identity and the Target Lock / Perfect Line ranged-combat theme. Completely replace the white executive suit and smooth corporate helmet. The user wants an ASSASSIN who is a HIGH-ACCURACY FIGHTER. Make the assassin identity immediately obvious in silhouette, clothing, targeting equipment and disciplined pose. This is concept artwork only, not a gameplay screenshot.
NEW DESIGN: an original adult male cyberpunk stealth assassin, lean athletic human proportions, compact dangerous presence, narrow waist, strong forearms and careful body language. A fitted angular charcoal technical hood frames a low-profile full-face graphite stealth mask. No exposed hair or skin, no white helmet, no shiny oval face shell. Mask has one tiny precision optical lens inset over his right eye with concentric cobalt rings and a thin horizontal blue sensor slit over the other eye; restrained geometric lower-face vent pattern, no skull motif. His matte black fitted stealth bodysuit has textured ballistic fabric, subtly layered carbon armor, slim gunmetal chest and shoulder plates, diagonally routed low-profile utility harness and a SHORT asymmetrical split shoulder scarf ending above the waist. Tailored articulated trousers, clean narrow calf silhouette, compact soft ninja-style footwear, small flexible shin guards. No baggy cargo pants, no white suit, no long coat, no huge boots or bulky pauldrons. The silhouette is agile and clearly different from a street courier or armored tank.
NEON: thin precise COBALT BLUE emissive seams run along the hood edge, one collar line, selected arm armor and ankle hardware. Small cool-white targeting indicators and a few tiny coral-red lock-on LEDs. Mostly obsidian/graphite, very selective bright accents, realistic rough fabrics contrast with satin carbon and brushed titanium. Keep readable under neutral key lighting, not swallowed by shadows.
HIGH-ACCURACY WEAPON IDENTITY: an elegant slim forearm-mounted precision energy-needle projector, flush integrated into his right bracer. Three very small razor-straight cobalt-white holographic needles hover in alignment above the wrist, a faint rangefinder guide and small crosshair projection near his fingers. He aims with deliberate controlled posture, left hand supports his right forearm, not a martial-arts flourish. No physical gun or rifle, no sword, no melee blade in hand. These are clean directed energy projectiles and tiny impact sparks, no fire, no lightning branches, no blood, no magic staff.
HOVERBOARD: ONE connected very low-profile stealth hoverboard, black carbon monocoque, a single pointed beveled nose and compact chiseled tail, broad enough continuous deck for both feet, grippy inset pads and flush cobalt lift strips hidden under the side edges. No forked nose, wheels, exposed engines, gigantic exhaust, decorative fins or detached hovering shoes. Both feet firmly supported on the SAME complete board in a low stable diagonal riding stance, knees slightly flexed, athlete preparing a perfect shot. Whole board with both tips fits in frame, small visible air gap over a dark wet studio floor, soft reflected blue light.
LAYOUT: premium landscape character-development sheet, charcoal studio background with fine restrained drafting lines. Large full-body three-quarter hero render on left with hood, both hands, feet and entire board uncropped. Right side: a smaller rear three-quarter view of the SAME outfit and hood; a large closeup of the asymmetric precision mask/optical targeting lens; detail of wrist energy-needle projector; clean isolated hoverboard side profile. Small lower-right action vignette: ZERO in a low precise aiming stance on his board, one thin white-cobalt needle shot passes through three aligned simple holographic enemy targets, crisp coral crosshair marks at their cores and tiny angular impact chips. Do not draw broad explosive effects or arcing electricity. Balanced composition, adequate negative space, stunning realistic 3D game-concept finish, believable material microdetail, restrained cinematic bloom, high-clarity silhouette for a top-down game.
Text only: ZERO and PRECISION ASSASSIN in small elegant cyberpunk typography. No stats, no other labels, no logos, no watermark. Original design, do not imitate a named film, comic or game character. Target Lock and Perfect Line perks remain unchanged.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.description: Three direct player-weapon hits on one enemy within 2 seconds mark it for 4 seconds. Player weapons deal 25% extra damage to the marked enemy. Only one mark can be active; a new mark cannot replace a live mark. Summons, secondary explosions and damage-over-time ticks do not build the mark.

perks.name: Perfect Line
perks.description: Every third projectile cast gives its first projectile two additional pierces, with a distinct cobalt-white trail. Other projectiles in the same volley are unchanged. Area pulses, beams and summons are excluded.

tradeoff: 20% smaller area-damage radius; targeting range and projectile collision size are unchanged.
